description: Capture every Claude Code session in a git repo into tars: link it to its task, or hold it as unfiled when it changed code. Silent when tars isn't installed or capture is off (tars capture off).

hooks.command: command -v tars >/dev/null 2>&1 && tars hook prompt 2>/dev/null; exit 0
command -v tars >/dev/null 2>&1 && tars hook end 2>/dev/null; exit 0
